_readme: THE config file — everything you might switch lives here. (1) Switch page: set pageId (or igUsername) + a FRESH metaUserToken (Graph API Explorer) and push; the agent mints the new page's permanent token on the next run and saves it to pageAccessToken automatically. (2) pageAccessToken: permanent page token — posting keeps working even after metaUserToken expires (page tokens never expire). (3) Pause everything: set autoPost to false (the GitHub Actions runner reads it live; force runs still work). (4) Schedule: slots + timezone (currently ONE post per day at 06:00 EAT). (5) IG catch-up window after slot time: graceMinutes (420 = 06:00-13:00 EAT, ending 10:00 UTC — the same window-END time Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali reliably posts within; the 06:00 EAT slot is the earliest of the three pages and GitHub drops most 03:00-07:00 UTC fires, so the window must contain the reliable 07:30-09:45 UTC landing cluster. Past it that day's IG is skipped — sibling pages force-rescue it the same afternoon, or the force button posts just the IG half manually). (6) Mutual rescue: 'siblings' lists the pages this agent watches — any landed run here dispatches a sibling whose IG half is due but has no landed run of its own (token: the DISPATCH_TOKEN repo secret (fine-grained PAT with contents:read + actions:write on the sibling repos — never remove its repo scopes: the 10-05 scope loss silently killed the rescue net and caused missed posts on 10-01 and 10-07)). Your pages: Teacher's Lesson Plan=928221430831 (@teachers_lesson_plan), Ladies Of Destiny=710815315448 (@ladies_of_destiny_), Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali=447560908444853 (@biblia_tafsiri_mbalimbali), RHEMA Miembeni - Bukoba=1091066014250146 (@rhemamiembenibukoba), Harvest Mission Secondary School=437296036362622 (@bwillson77). Public-repo secret policy (since 2026-10-17): This repo is PUBLIC since 2026-10-17 (free unlimited Actions runtime, ubuntu-latest) — so NO secret values live in this file anymore: they are ENCRYPTED GitHub repo secrets (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions): META_USER_TOKEN, PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN, META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET, DISPATCH_TOKEN. The workflow passes them as env vars; the agent prefers env over this file (empty-env safe). To rotate a token: update the repo secret — never paste tokens into this public file. (If a secret is missing AND this file has no value, the run posts nothing and logs 'No working token yet' — recover by setting the secret.)
